howItWorks.title: How SafeHaven Works
howItWorks.description: Your journey to safety and resolution starts here. Completely anonymous and secure.

step1.title: Safe Report
step1.description: Share your experience through our secure, encrypted portal. No identity required, no logs kept. Your safety is our starting point.

step2.title: Compassionate Review
step2.description: Our trauma-informed team reviews your case. We focus on your needs and connect you with verified local support networks.

step3.title: Guided Recovery
step3.description: Access resources for healing and justice at your own pace. Stay connected via secure channels as you rebuild and move forward.

cta.title: Ready to Begin Your Journey?
cta.description: Every service provider in our directory is manually verified by administrators to ensure the highest standards of care and safety.

security.title: Your Identity is Hidden
security.description: Your safety and privacy are our foundation. We built SafeHaven on a Zero-Trust framework, ensuring that even we cannot see who you are.

zeroTrust.title: Zero-Trust Protocol
zeroTrust.description: No privileged access. Every request is verified, and metadata is never stored.

encryption.title: E2E Encryption
encryption.description: Encrypted the moment you type. Only specialists with shared keys can decrypt.

chatbot.welcome: Here to help you navigate our services
chatbot.greeting: Hi! I can help you with questions about SafeHaven. What would you like to know?

questions.ml_logic: How does the ML risk assessment work?

answers.emergency: If you are in immediate danger, please call emergency services (911) or contact local authorities. SafeHaven also has emergency support available 24/7.
answers.reporting: You can submit a report through our anonymous reporting form. Your identity will be protected, and the report will be reviewed by our team within 24 hours.
answers.privacy: Your privacy is our priority. All reports can be submitted anonymously. We use encryption and strict access controls to protect your information.
answers.ml_logic: Our ML system analyzes reports to assess risk levels and prioritize cases. This helps counselors focus on urgent cases first. The system is continuously monitored for fairness.
answers.legal: We connect you with legal aid organizations, pro bono lawyers, and can help you understand your rights. Legal support is confidential and free for survivors.
answers.support: SafeHaven provides access to counselors, medical providers, and support groups. You can connect with professionals through our secure messaging system.
answers.missing: If someone is missing, you can report it through our missing persons portal. We work with authorities and NGOs to help locate missing individuals.
answers.system: SafeHaven is a comprehensive platform for reporting gender-based violence, accessing support services, and tracking case progress securely.
answers.how_it_works: SafeHaven allows you to report incidents anonymously, track your case status, access support resources, and connect with counselors and legal professionals—all in one secure platform.
answers.fallback: I'm here to help with questions about SafeHaven. You can ask about reporting, privacy, support services, legal aid, or how the system works.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about SafeHaven's services and support.
faq.q1: How long does it take to get a response?
faq.a1: We typically respond within 24 hours for email inquiries and immediately for phone support during business hours.
faq.a2: Yes, all communications are encrypted and handled with the highest level of confidentiality. We never share personal information without explicit consent.
faq.a3: Yes, our live chat is available 24/7, and emergency support is always accessible. Phone support is available during business hours.
faq.q4: How can I report an accessibility issue?
faq.a4: You can report accessibility issues through our contact form, by calling our support line, or using the Report an Issue button on our accessibility page.
faq.q5: What information should I include when contacting support?
faq.a5: Please provide as much detail as possible about your issue, including any error messages, what you were trying to do, and your contact information for follow-up.
faq.q6: Do you provide training or workshops?
faq.a6: Yes, we offer various training programs and workshops. Contact our partnerships team for information about available programs.
